summary: The stakeholder emphasizes the importance of the E-Rate Program for their district and opposes any termination or weakening of the program.

claims.argument: The program allows Wareham Public Schools to build a robust network at a lower cost than other districts
claims.evidence_quote: I cannot overstate the importance of the E-RATE Program and the value that it brings to Wareham Public Schools. Because of E-Rate the district has been able to build a sophisticated, robust, and fast wired/wireless network that connects our students to the online and digital resources they require for their learning. Without E-RATE, our district would struggle to afford new networking equipment and ISP services. This program allows us to keep pace with more fortunate districts.
